frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: YES... YES, I REMEMBER NOW. I AM CIRCUITUS, MASTER OF THE RHYTHM CORE. I WILL HELP YOU.

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: THE RHYTHM CORE IS REPAIRED. BUT TO FULLY REACTIVATE IT, WE NEED TO CREATE A HARMONIC CONVERGENCE. THE FINAL STEP MUST BE PERFORMED AT THE CENTRAL HUB.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: MOTHER BOARD AWAITS US THERE. LET US GO, TRAVELLER, AND BRING BACK THE MUSIC TO ELECTRONOVA.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: HERE WE ARE, THE CENTRAL HUB. MOTHER BOARD AWAITS.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: She's impressive. But we need to bring her back online. What's the next step, Circuitus?

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: TO REACTIVATE MOTHER BOARD, WE MUST CHANNEL THE RHYTHM CORE'S ENERGY INTO HER MAINFRAME. THIS REQUIRES A HARMONIC CONVERGENCE. BOTH DIODES AND FUSEONS MUST SYNCHRONIZE THEIR BEATS IN PERFECT HARMONY.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: How do we achieve this convergence?

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: THE DIODES AND FUSEONS MUST UNITE, EACH PLAYING THEIR PART IN A SYMPHONY OF SOUND. BUT YEARS OF SILENCE HAVE MADE THIS DIFFICULT.

frames.heading: Circuitus
frames.body: IT'S TRUE. WE MUST GUIDE THEM BACK TO THEIR ROOTS, TO THE BEATS THAT ONCE UNITED US.

frames.heading: Diode
frames.body: FELLOW DIODES, REMEMBER THE RHYTHM THAT ONCE FLOWED THROUGH OUR CIRCUITS. LET US JOIN TOGETHER AND REVIVE THE BEATS OF ELECTRONOVA!

frames.heading: Fuseon
frames.body: FUSEONS, THE TRAVELLER HAS AWAKENED US TO THE POWER OF GROOVE. LET US UNITE WITH OUR DIODE BRETHREN AND BRING BACK THE MUSIC!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Feel the music, let it guide you. Let's bring Mother Board back to life!
